description: This file defines a Flutter widget representing a catalog page, including UI elements for category filtering and displaying a grid of books. It interacts with application state through Provider and fetches categories asynchronously from a mocked API.

classes.name: CatalogPage
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a list of book categories and a grid of books, allowing users to filter by category and navigate to detailed book view.

classes.name: _CatalogPageState
classes.description: State class managing category filtering and book grid display for CatalogPage.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state and asynchronously loads categories from the API once the widget is inserted into the widget tree.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI, including category choice chips and a grid of books, updating UI based on provider state and loading status.
